covWinT.script:
//@version=6
indicator("cov win ternary")
c3 = hour % 3 != 0
cr = close > open
g = hour % 7 == 0 ? na : close
r = hour % 11 < 3 ? na : close
bool anch = time >= timestamp("2026-10-03T00:00:00+0000")
bbU(float s, int l) =>
    [m, u, lo] = ta.bb(s, l, 2)
    u
dmiF(int k) =>
    [p, m, a] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
    k == 0 ? p : k == 1 ? m : a
kcU(float s) =>
    [m, u, lo] = ta.kc(s, 20, 1.5)
    u
macdF(float s, int k) =>
    [mm, sg, hh] = ta.macd(s, 12, 26, 9)
    k == 0 ? mm : k == 1 ? sg : hh
stF(int k) =>
    [v, d] = ta.supertrend(3, 10)
    k == 0 ? v : d

    array.get(ta.pivot_point_levels("Traditional", timeframe.change("D")), k)
